name: drive-sonar-linux-dev
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev pkg-config build-essential libssl-dev npm && case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in amd64) sccache_target=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl ;; arm64) sccache_target=aarch64-unknown-linux-musl ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture for sccache: $(dpkg --print-architecture)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac && curl -L https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/releases/latest/download/sccache-v0.8.2-${sccache_target}.tar.gz | tar xz -C /tmp && sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/sccache-*/sccache /usr/local/bin/sccache
